heading: Transfer of functions of Office of Election Administration of Federal Election Commission
lead: There are transferred to the Election Assistance Commission established under section 20921 of this title all functions which the Office of Election Administration, established within the Federal Election Commission, exercised before October 29, 2002.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 15531 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

ancestors.heading: TRANSFER TO COMMISSION OF FUNCTIONS UNDER CERTAIN LAWS
